title.zh: 【韩国金融服务委员会主席：《数字资产基本法》的磋商已进入最后阶段】
title.en: 【韩国金融服务委员会主席：《数字资产基本法》的磋商已进入最后阶段】

current_state.zh: South Korea's FSC Chairman Lee Eog-weon told a National Assembly hearing that deliberations on the Digital Asset Basic Act are nearly complete and the government will push to introduce the framework—covering exchange licensing, stablecoin issuance rules and clearer legal definitions—as soon as possible, while saying crypto taxation should account for various circumstances as the repeatedly delayed levy is set for January 1, 2027.
